5839.title: [M158] Sync upstream Skia bug fixes
5839.body:
[M158] Sync upstream Skia bug fixes (#5839)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/469
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/6ff3072bb76eabbfe07038592d739349dc583979...b4574ecb9b4292951c64ddce5619628fdaf0451d

Advance the release/4.158.x native engine to the latest chrome/m158 fixes.
The parent changes the native pin and its provenance metadata without changing
managed APIs, generated bindings, package versions, or dependency pins.

~~ Surface Ganesh flush failures ~~

Low-level draw and upload failures could silently drop work. Propagate
failures and abandon the context when recovery is unsafe. Failed promise-image
fulfillment remains nonfatal: the flush's work is dropped, but the context
stays usable for Chrome's direct and deferred-display-list paths.

~~ Guard Ganesh buffer allocations against overflow ~~

Unchecked alignment, padding, and element-size arithmetic could wrap and
write out of bounds. Use checked arithmetic, reject invalid sizes, make CPU
buffer allocation fallible, and cap block and vertex-chunk allocations.

~~ Bound Imagination MSAA footprints ~~

Power-of-two alignment can make multisampled color or stencil attachments
exceed 32-bit footprint limits. Reject oversized render targets and dynamic
MSAA attachments on affected Imagination GL, ANGLE, and Vulkan devices.

~~ Avoid unsafe Vulkan descriptor-pool destruction ~~

Imagination descriptor allocation can report host or device OOM before the
context is lost. Mark affected pools as leaked rather than destroy them in
that state; Graphite also rejects a null pool handle.

~~ Restrict destination reads to their bounds ~~

Geometry can extend beyond incorrectly calculated draw bounds. Intersect the
pipeline scissor with destination-read bounds so those pixels cannot read
outside the intended destination region.

~~ Correct FreeType LCD16 bounds and cropping ~~

Stateful font scalers can produce different glyph bounds between loads.
Convert FreeType's three-times-scaled LCD bitmap bounds to pixel coordinates
before intersecting, validate the bitmap format and dimensions, and crop
source and destination consistently. Guard outline translation and image
buffer bounds as well.

~~ Preserve Graphite painter order after overwrites ~~

A full-overwrite draw discards earlier draws but previously left depth
advancing until it could wrap. Reset depth and its associated bounds managers
when an overwrite occurs after the initial clear.

~~ Prevent scratch texels from entering filtered images ~~

Ganesh image filtering could use mipmaps from approximate-fit scratch
textures and incorporate unwritten texels. Share the safe-sampling downgrade
between shader and texture draws for non-exact-fit special images. Mark the
mipmap test helpers potentially unused for configurations that do not call
them.

~~ Record landed native ancestry without changing reviewed sources ~~

Update the gitlink and Component Governance commitHash to native merge
b4574ecb9b4292951c64ddce5619628fdaf0451d and record chrome/m158 commit
37e919d8669ebe4a8912dcef03db14b9b55f70c7. The native merge has two parents,
directly contains reviewed head 57713b14b00355c3f07929feed64d0143eba9ba0,
and shares its tree 6376fcc82c881e7c055d8d7b918e41b4f70906a0.

Independent regeneration matched the five binding trees. The review found no
fork-patch, interop, or DEPS changes. Tree equality preserves the reviewed
native content through the repin; it is not a new runtime test run.
